question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a documented deprecated compatibility alias for shipped third-party channel plugins, or require affected plugins to republish against `channel.inbound` only?
rationale: The code path is a narrow compatibility repair, but it changes the public plugin runtime contract and makes the legacy name supported again until maintainers define a removal/deprecation boundary.

options.title: Accept Deprecated Alias
options.body: Approve the object-identical `turn` alias after conflict refresh so old compiled channel plugins recover without per-plugin releases.

options.title: Require Plugin Republishes
options.body: Reject the alias and keep `channel.inbound` as the only runtime name, accepting that older third-party channel builds remain broken until republished.

options.title: Accept With Expiration Plan
options.body: Land the alias only with an explicit documented compatibility window and follow-up removal criteria.

recommendation.title: Accept Deprecated Alias
recommendation.body: Approve the object-identical `turn` alias after conflict refresh so old compiled channel plugins recover without per-plugin releases.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person authored the removal commit and is the clearest routing owner for the API compatibility decision.
